component.name: Universal Linux Troubleshooter
component.summary: Read-only Linux diagnostics and guided troubleshooting

description.p: Universal Linux Troubleshooter helps you investigate hardware and software problems with read-only checks and practical, evidence-based guidance.
Choose a complete system scan or investigate a specific symptom. Results separate observed findings from possible causes and link relevant findings to documented troubleshooting topics.

ul.li: Run up to 72 local diagnostic measurements in a complete system scan.
Search 250 documented problem cases, 500 conditional solution routes and 143 additional guides.
Inspect diagnoses, solutions and detailed evidence separately.
Repeat checks after you decide whether to act on a recommendation.
Use offline documentation; external network checks require your explicit permission.

description.p: ULTS does not perform automatic repairs and does not require an AI service.
Host diagnostics require broad read-only filesystem access and permission to run approved inspection commands on the host system.
Initial Universal Linux Troubleshooter release candidate.

ul.li: Manual Diagnostics and complete system scan with topic-linked solutions.
Offline troubleshooting catalog and detailed diagnostic evidence.
Cross-distribution host inspection from the Flatpak test bundle.
